documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Revised Annoucement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.
Intimation Of Execution Of Memorandum Of Understanding For Proposed Acquisition.
Financial Results Of Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Dachepalli Publishers Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and profitability growth alongside strategic backward integration into notebook manufacturing through advanced machinery acquisition. The company continues to expand its geographic reach, enhance its digital and hybrid educational offerings via WeStudy, and scale its school-linked e-commerce and distribution platforms. Management emphasized operational excellence, institutional partnerships, and disciplined execution to sustain growth across the K-12 education ecosystem. Dachepalli Publishers Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by higher textbook sales, expanded geographical presence across 15 states, and growth in its e-commerce and notebook businesses. Management highlighted that paper raw material prices have declined post-COVID, and new national curriculum guidelines have improved production and cost efficiencies.

guidance.claim: The company is looking at a business trajectory of over 150 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: So, right now, we are at a trajectory of INR 150 crores plus business is what we are looking at.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a PAT of around 25 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are estimating a PAT of around INR 25 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve between 200 and 250 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: It will be around 200 to 250 somewhere in between like INR 220-230 crores definitely we will be achieving.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company has begun FY27 with encouraging momentum across its publishing and integrated education businesses.
demand_outlook.quote: We have begun FY27 with encouraging momentum across our publishing and integrated education businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The education sector continues to experience steady demand, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, which is supported by curriculum expansion and institutional requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: The education sector continues to witness steady demand, particularly across Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, supported by curriculum expansion and institutional requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired advanced notebook manufacturing machinery for in-house production through the acquisition of a Linomatic Flexo print notebook manufacturing machine.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquisition of Linomatic Flexo print notebook manufacturing machine

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded full-fledged operations into Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Assam.
capex_expansion.quote: Commenced full-fledged operations in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, & Assam.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired advanced notebook manufacturing machinery to transition from trading notebooks to in-house manufacturing.
capex_expansion.quote: We acquired advanced notebook manufacturing machinery, enabling us to gradually transition from trading notebooks to in-house manufacturing.

capex_expansion.claim: Printing capacity currently stands at approximately 15 tons per day.
capex_expansion.quote: Our printing capacity currently stands at approximately 15 tons per day, with capacity utilization improving to nearly 75% during the year compared to nearly 40% earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that backward integration will lead to improved gross margins.
margins_costs.quote: Improved gross margins through backward integration

margins_costs.claim: Raw material paper prices came down significantly from INR 120 per kilo during COVID to INR 65 per kilo last year.
margins_costs.quote: During COVID in 2020, I purchased raw material at INR 120 per kilo, which is paper. And 70% of the products in textbook is paper in our business. And last year, I purchased paper at INR 65 per kilo.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins are expected to be around 16% to 17%.
margins_costs.quote: You know, PAT will be around 16% to 17% of PAT. So, on that basis, you calculate the EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: The acquisition of the notebook manufacturing machine is expected to improve gross margins through backward integration.
margins_costs.quote: • Improved gross margins through backward integration

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported an installed printing capacity of 15 tonnes per day with current utilization at approximately 75% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Current utilization at ~75% of installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company supplies textbooks to around 10,000 schools across 15 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: we are currently supplying textbooks to schools across three different boards, that is CBSE, ICSE and State board to around 10,000 schools in 15 states in India.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity is 15 tonnes per day across multiple fiscal years.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed Capacity 15 tonnes per day 15 tonnes per day 15 tonnes per day 15 tonnes per day

capital_allocation.claim: The company will not be declaring a dividend this year as it is a growing company.
capital_allocation.quote: Right now, we are a growing company. Maybe we will probably declare next year after once we reach a certain target which are there in our mind. But this year, no dividend.

management_commitments.claim: The in-house notebook manufacturing will become fully operational in the next 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: In the next one month. In the next 30 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to get into all 28 states and 8 union territories of the country in the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, in the next 3 years, my target is to get into all the 28 states and 8 union territories of the country.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to do more than 500 crores of turnover in the next five to six years.
management_commitments.quote: So, my target is in the next five to six years, I should be able to do more than INR 500 crores of turnover with a mixture of all these products, textbooks, uniform, stationery and notebook.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
